# stalwart_certificate (Resource)

Defines a TLS certificate and its associated private key.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `certificate` (Attributes) TLS certificate in PEM format (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificate))
- `private_key` (Attributes) Private key in PEM format (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private_key))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
- `issuer` (String) Certificate issuer
- `not_valid_after` (String) Expiration date of the certificate
- `not_valid_before` (String) Issuance date of the certificate
- `subject_alternative_names` (Set of String) Subject Alternative Names (SAN) for the certificate

<a id="nestedatt--certificate"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificate`

Required:

- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.

Optional:

- `file_path` (String) File path to read the secret from
- `value` (String) Text value
- `variable_name` (String) Environment variable name to read the secret from


<a id="nestedatt--private_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `private_key`

Required:

- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.

Optional:

- `file_path` (String) File path to read the secret from
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Password or secret value
- `variable_name` (String) Environment variable name to read the secret from
